items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Tatsu. Tatsu. Tatsu. Tatsu. Tatsu. Well. That's when he got Joe all over.

ctx.x: Well, I played. Eddie was playing. Eddie played the trampoline. We had our band played in there. Eddie played the saxophone. That's right. He played that at night. Sam Langford. Then he left. Then he left on out of here. Yes, that's what it is. I played that at night.

He did saxophone. Then he come back. He come back and trying to get Joe all over the first time. and he couldn't get him. Joe all over the world and go. Then he left and go back and come back when his sister was sick there. What a name that guru one. Eddie's sister. Uh, shaman. No. Uh, Tatsu. Tatsu. Tatsu. Tatsu. Tatsu. Well. That's when he got Joe all over.
Well, I want to tell you something about this boy playing trombone. Lindsay boy. Oh, yeah.
